description: Experimental DSM-5-TR-based schizophrenia diagnostic criteria checklist. A structured record of the six required criteria and their subconditions; the evaluating clinician makes the diagnosis, never the checklist alone.

items.prompt: Delusions: fixed beliefs despite compelling contrary evidence, not ordinarily accepted in the person's culture (active phase)?
Hallucinations: perception-like experiences without external stimulus, with ordinary-perception vividness (active phase)?
Disorganized speech reflecting disordered thought: frequent derailment, tangentiality, or incoherence (active phase)?
Markedly disorganized behavior interfering with goal-directed activity/self-care, or a qualifying catatonic syndrome (active phase)?
Negative symptoms: especially reduced emotional expression or markedly reduced initiation/persistence of purposeful activity (active phase)?
Functioning in at least one major area (work, education, relationships, self-care) clearly below the prior level, or failure to reach the expected level when onset precedes adult roles?
Continuous signs of the disturbance for at least 6 months (not six uninterrupted months of full-intensity psychosis)?
At least 1 month of active-phase symptoms meeting Criterion A?
Was the active phase shorter than 1 month because effective intervention abbreviated it?
Mood-disorder/schizoaffective exclusion satisfied: no concurrent major depressive/manic episode with the active psychosis, or mood episodes occupied only a minority of the total course?
Substance/medication/medical exclusion satisfied: syndrome not better explained by a substance, medication, toxin, withdrawal, or another medical/neurological condition?
Is autism spectrum disorder or a childhood-onset communication disorder already present?
Prominent delusions or hallucinations present together with the other required features for at least 1 month (or less if intervention shortened the phase)?

periods.window: same 1-month active-phase interval (or shorter if intervention abbreviated it)

assumptions: Checklist records clinician judgments; every item is answered by the assessing clinician from interview and collateral, never auto-derived.
Item prompts condense the source guideline into one question each; they are documentation of what was asked, not replacement diagnostic text.
'yes' means the clinician determined the subcondition is satisfied; 'unknown' means it could not be determined; unanswered means it was not assessed.
release.disclaimer: Experimental assessment package. Implementation validation replaces owner approval for this release; this does NOT establish clinical validation and introduces no treatment thresholds.
experimental_defaults: Explicit 'unknown' answers are permitted and distinct from unanswered; a criterion whose outcome is undecided by yes/unknown inputs is 'unknown'.
A complete record with no 'not_met' criterion but some 'unknown' is 'indeterminate' overall: it is never labeled 'below_threshold'.
Bypass is recorded as answers {'__bypass': true} and evaluates to status 'bypassed'; attribution (actor/time) is the consumer's responsibility (S09).
A shortened active phase (c_shortened_by_intervention=yes) satisfies the 1-month active requirement alongside continuous 6-month signs.
f_prominent_psychosis is required if and only if f_autism_present=yes; otherwise criterion F is satisfied without it.
release.release_notes: Released for S09 diagnosis implementation. No owner review or approval required or recorded.
source_gaps: The source gives no structured item wording; prompts here condense guideline prose into checklist questions (clinician judgment, not verbatim criteria).
'Substantial part of 1 month' (A), 'meaningful portion' (B), and 'minority of the total course' (D) have no numeric cutoffs in the source and are left to clinician judgment.
'Prominent' delusions/hallucinations (F) is not quantified in the source.
The source defines no universal test panel for exclusion E; workup is history/examination-driven per the source.
Prodromal/residual attenuated symptoms are represented inside the duration items, not as separate checklist items.

validation_results.notes: Reference examples live in backend/tests/assessments/test_definitions.py (slice 3) and were worked independently from the source.

source.note: All six criteria A-F with subconditions; symptom count alone cannot satisfy the full document.

title: Schizophrenia diagnostic criteria checklist (experimental v1)
